name: core-workflow
title: Core workflow
description: This vignette walks through the standard tidyfault pipeline from tidy node and edge tables to minimal cutsets and a coverage summary, using the bundled database failure example.

name: quantify-binary
title: quantify()-ing binary outcomes
description: quantify() evaluates whether the top event occurs under each scenario. With the default prob = FALSE, inputs are binary (failed / not failed) for each basic event.

name: quantify-probabilities
title: quantify()-ing probabilities
description: With prob = TRUE, quantify() treats each column as a failure probability for that basic event and returns the top-event probability for each row (assuming independence in the fast implementation).

name: simulating-uncertainty
title: Simulating uncertainty
description: When point estimates of basic-event probabilities are uncertain, you can simulate rates or probabilities, evaluate the top event for each draw with quantify(..., prob = TRUE), and summarize the resulting distribution. This follows the IT security workflow in the tidyfault paper.

name: visualizing-fault-trees
title: Visualizing fault trees
description: tidyfault builds fault-tree plots on top of ggplot2 and ggraph. The workhorse is illustrate(), which lays out nodes and edges; the plot() method returns a ggplot object you can extend.
